answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 59 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The beacon register is checked at draw time, grove lists the eligible set, and walnut seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 59 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat forfeits for every seat it wants. Each impostor pays 12 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
